Title: Public preview: Test action groups in Azure Monitor

Body.Content:
The Azure Monitor test action groups feature enables you to test the notification settings for your alerts. Using the test action group feature enables you to:

  • Test if notifications are working as expected when creating or updating an action group.
  • Self-diagnose the cause of notifications not working as expected.

Learn more.
